sourceSnapshot: Retained historical CERRA source snapshot used for the frozen task oracles, not current live Maryland totals.
marylandOracle: Nine frozen Maryland reference payloads were replayed before the final extension. Read-only SQL anchors support query counts. This is not an independent audit of original crash-report collection or all upstream transformations.
hinOracle: A separate Python pass computed HIN numeric expectations over the six retained JSON exports without importing application queryData, factualAnswer, reconcilePlan or model code. These exports share the application’s upstream extraction.
documentaryLabelLimitation: Historical source label, not an independently verified full report title.
limitations: Source hashes identify bytes but do not independently establish correctness.
Oracle computational independence is not independent source collection, ETL validation, clinical/causal validity, or validation of HIN methodology.
Published expected aggregates and source-feature summaries support question/rubric review; reviewers cannot independently reconstruct every original query from this package alone.
